note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Lakewood-Laona District) on the southwest corner of Bear Lake: sites along a wooded ridge above the shore, many looking at the lake through hardwoods and pines; five walk-in tent sites on a wooded peninsula. Swim beach and boat landing. Popular with grouse hunters and for fall color. ATVs and UTVs are barred in the campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS read: $15, 27 nonelectric sites (5 walk-in tent), 16 reservable late May-Labor Day with a 4-day cutoff, the rest first-come; 2027 season 04-29 to 11-29. Stored max_rig_ft 30 is wrong (13 sites 45 ft+, catalog to 64). Lakeview confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakeview confirmed. The shore-side sites 3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, 15, 17, 18, 20 and 22 (e.g. 008 at 45.51276,-88.53007, 017 at 45.51065,-88.52992) sit ~15-30 m from the water on imagery but on a wooded ridge under continuous hardwood-pine canopy; their rec.gov photos show the lake between tree trunks beyond each pad. rec.gov tags these 11 RV sites (plus walk-ins 23-27) 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'; under the canopy rule they are views. All are nightly (6, 10, 11, 17, 20, 22 reservable; 3, 5, 8, 15, 18 first-come).
MAX LENGTH: stored max_rig_ft 30 (from the old note) is wrong: FS lists 13 sites as 'Back in 45+ feet' and the rec.gov catalog posts Max Vehicle Length up to 64.
SEASON: 2027 runs 04-29 to 11-29 (rec.gov rate seasons); stored 04-30/11-30 is the 2026 calendar.
